description.Name: LibriBrain: Sherlock 1 sample

latestSnapshot.readme:
Relationship to the full dataset
--------------------------------

This OpenNeuro release is a small excerpt of LibriBrain, containing a single MEG session from one subject (sherlock1/ses-1). It is provided to support dataset discoverability, BIDS validation, inspection of the file structure, and lightweight testing of data-loading pipelines.

The full LibriBrain dataset is considerably larger (>50 hours), comprising multiple sessions recorded while the participant listened to Sherlock Holmes books 1–7. (MEG data for additional subjects and for the final two Sherlock books, 8 and 9, are included in LibriBrain2 totalling >100 hours combined, also on Hugging Face.) The full dataset is not released on OpenNeuro because OpenNeuro datasets are distributed under a CC0 licence, which grants unrestricted commercial reuse. To promote open research and to protect the public good, we have instead chosen to distribute the full dataset separately under open, non-commercial research terms (CC BY-NC 4.0).

This is a deliberate data-governance and ethical decision, as LibriBrain is a publicly funded, participant-contributed neural dataset. Releasing the full dataset under non-commercial terms is intended to preserve its value for the research community while avoiding unrestricted commercial extraction without appropriate accountability and permission.

The full dataset is available via Hugging Face under its own licence (CC BY-NC 4.0):

https://huggingface.co/datasets/pnpl/LibriBrain

LibriBrain2 (additional subjects and Sherlock books 8–9) is also available under the same licence (CC BY-NC 4.0):

https://huggingface.co/datasets/pnpl/LibriBrain2

Citation
--------

If you use this OpenNeuro sample directly, please cite this OpenNeuro dataset.

If you use the full dataset, please cite the associated paper and the full Hugging Face dataset.
